boards.name: Interior design product list
boards.description: Track furniture, lighting and finishes to source for a scheme — with photos, suppliers, costs, lead times and status — against the budget.

cards.title: Product schedule — ground floor, Victorian terrace
cards.body: Everything we are buying for the living room, kitchen-diner and hall, in one place. Budget £42,000.

cards.title: How to use this template
cards.body: One row per item with supplier, cost, lead time and status. Photos sit above the table so the client sees what they’re approving. Total the budget column before every client meeting.
